title: PDSSP Planetary Data Schema for STACPlanet Items and Collections
description: Profile defining PDSSP-specific constraints for planetary data products. Applies to both STAC Items and Collections. Required extensions on an Item depend on whether the product is located: a null geometry relaxes the projection requirement.

ssys:targets.description: List of solar system targets covered by the data, each the preferred label of a concept of the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Target scheme (e.g. "Mars", "Phobos", "Mars Global Surveyor", "C/2013 A1 (Siding Spring)"). At least one, no duplicates. Source spellings ("MARS", "Mgs", "Jupitr") must be normalised before ingestion (normaliser in search/facets.json of the thesaurus); an unknown target is rejected until it is added to the thesaurus.

ssys:target_class.description: Classification of the primary target: a notation of the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Target Class scheme, i.e. a PADC EPN target-class term, restricted to the 13 values the ssys v1.1.1 extension accepts. The class of each target is given by the thesaurus (pdssp:targetClass), so it can be derived from ssys:targets.

version.description: Version identifier for the data product. Mandatory for items.

product:type.description: Type of the data product: a concept of the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Product Type scheme -- deliberately NOT the EPN-TAP dataproduct_type vocabulary, which is coarser (no orthoimage or anaglyph); the EPN-TAP mapping is in the thesaurus mapping sets. This field is mandatory.

processing:level.description: Processing level of the data product: a concept of the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Processing Level scheme (PDS4 levels). This field is mandatory.

pdssp:method.description: How the product was acquired or produced (the technique): a concept of the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Method scheme, which reuses the USGS Thesaurus "methods" facet and adds Photogrammetry and Stereoscopic imaging.

pdssp:wavelength_type.description: Spectral domains of the data: IVOA messenger terms (Optical, Infrared, UV, ...) from the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Wavelength Type scheme. Derivable from the band names: each band of the thesaurus gives the domain of its centre wavelength.

license.description: License under which the data is provided.

ssys:targets.description: List of solar system targets covered by this collection -- a top-level Collection field, a fact about the collection itself like its license, each the preferred label of a concept of the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Target scheme (e.g. "Mars", "Phobos", "Mars Global Surveyor", "C/2013 A1 (Siding Spring)"). At least one, no duplicates. Source spellings ("MARS", "Mgs", "Jupitr") must be normalised before ingestion (normaliser in search/facets.json of the thesaurus); an unknown target is rejected until it is added to the thesaurus.

ssys:target_class.description: Classification of this collection's primary target -- same values as the Item field.

product:type.description: Every product:type value this collection's items actually use, from the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Product Type scheme. This field is mandatory.

processing:level.description: Every processing:level value this collection's items actually use, from the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Processing Level scheme. This field is mandatory.

pdssp:method.description: Every pdssp:method value this collection's items actually use, from the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Method scheme.

pdssp:wavelength_type.description: Every pdssp:wavelength_type value this collection's items actually use, from the PDSSP Thesaurus (https://pdssp.github.io/pdssp-ontology/vocab/) Wavelength Type scheme.
